note: Every committed and local run flies a real in-sim brake test at mission start (mission_follower_node.py BRAKE_OUT/BRAKE_RUN/BRAKE_BACK phases, brake_test:=true): full speed, zero velocity commanded, distance to stop measured from the true simulator pose. The 3.0 m sensed clearance ring and 1.9 m/s cruise speed (SENSED_CLEARANCE_M, CRUISE_MPS in mission_follower_node.py) were sized against the WORST of these measured stops, not assumed. smoke1 fired the test before the drone reached cruise speed (0.005 m/s at the command) and is excluded as degenerate.

excluded_degenerate.reason: brake fired at 0.005 m/s (before cruise speed was reached); not a real deceleration measurement

used_in_safety_derivation: mission_follower_node.py declares DECEL_MPS2 = 1.95 (worse than every measured decel above, i.e. a conservative -- longer -- assumed stopping distance), so the derived stop distance and the 3.0 m ring both already have margin over the worst measured stop.
